title: Skeleton-First Recursive Build / Activation Order
critical_rule: print geometry and inactive device skeletons early; fill/activate vulnerable gas/electrochemical functions late

phases.name: high-energy backbone
phases.why: complete processes most likely to damage later functions

phases.name: passive electronics
phases.why: shared air/inert environment and high overlap

phases.name: device skeletons
operations: battery cavity/current collectors/electrodes but no electrolyte if later heat remains
plasma-cell cavity/electrodes/phosphor but no final gas fill
phases.why: prepare geometry without activating vulnerable contents

phases.name: precision finishing
phases.why: buried defects become expensive after closure

phases.name: active hybrid insertion / specialist thin films
operations: specialist printed semiconductor/PV layers where validated

phases.name: local environment activation
phases.why: late activation protects gas/electrolyte purity and prevents repeated chamber-wide cycling

phases.name: functional test before burial
operations: spectral/plasma check at bounded test condition
phases.why: no final overbuild over an unverified subsystem

phases.name: overbuild + shielding + enclosure
phases.why: turns verified modules into monolithic/near-monolithic functional body

gas_discharge_RGB.architecture: common noble-gas discharge family plus separate RGB phosphor/conversion regions
gas_discharge_RGB.key_simplification: red/green/blue need not require three different chamber gases
reference_literature_points: Ne/Xe is a standard plasma-display family
published PDP examples include 8% Xe in Ne at 400 Torr and 15% Xe in Ne at 450 Torr
these are historical comparator points only; UTP geometry/electrode/dielectric/phosphor system requires its own breakdown, efficiency and lifetime sweep
UTP_sequence: print dielectric cavity/ribs and electrode geometry
print/select phosphor/conversion layer for target colour
evacuate/purge local cell or local bank
recover manifold excess into dedicated noble-gas reservoir

true_LED_boundary: true semiconductor LED colour is set principally by semiconductor band structure/composition and junction design, not chamber fill gas; baseline UTP therefore embeds qualified LEDs/dies while PF-SEMIPRINT matures separately
photovoltaic_boundary: PV/thin-film functions may reuse fine deposition, controlled atmosphere, photonic/thermal treatment and strain/geometry programming, but each absorber/junction system requires its own material/process qualification
